individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap-type visualization of deconvolution scores per spot; equivalent to a heatmap, which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Box plots already display individual data points (colored dots for each biological replicate) overlaid on the boxes.
GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Bar chart shows single computed log2 fold-change values (with associated p-values) from a differential expression analysis rather than a mean of a small set of replicates, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
Panel consists of micrographs (H&E and IHC images), not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - spatial heatmap panel contains no error bars or box-plot elements.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; ...(minima=..., median=..., maxima=..., Q1=..., Q3=... for each group)
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - the caption explicitly defines the box plot elements (25th-75th percentile box, plus minima, median, maxima, Q1 and Q3 values for every group).
not needed - GSEA enrichment plots show a running score curve with no error bars.
not needed - bar chart bars have no visible error bars, only p-value annotations.
not needed - panel contains micrographs only, no error bars or box-plot elements.
